import { existsSync, readFileSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';

export interface JobRecord {
  jobId: string;
  status: string;
  inFlight: boolean;
  awaitingAck: boolean;
  settledAt: string | null;
  retries: number;
}

export function startJob(job: JobRecord): void {
  if (job.status === 'pending') {
    job.status = 'running';
  }
  if (job.retries >= 3) {
    job.status = 'failed';
  }
}

export function pauseJob(job: JobRecord): void {
  if (job.status === 'running') {
    job.status = 'paused';
  }
}

export function finishJob(job: JobRecord): void {
  if (job.status === 'running') {
    job.status = 'completed';
  }
  if (job.retries >= 5) {
    job.status = 'aborted';
  }
}

export function saveJob(path: string, job: JobRecord): void {
  const payload = {
    jobId: job.jobId,
    status: job.status,
    leaseToken: 'tok-2',
  };
  writeFileSync(path, JSON.stringify(payload));
}

export function loadJob(path: string): { jobId: string; status: string } {
  const raw = JSON.parse(readFileSync(path, 'utf8'));
  return {
    jobId: raw.jobId,
    status: raw.status,
  };
}

export function inferJobPhase(dir: string): string {
  if (existsSync(`${dir}/job_lock.flag`)) return 'locked';
  if (existsSync(`${dir}/job_checkpoint.json`)) return 'resuming';
  if (existsSync(`${dir}/job_done.marker`)) return 'done';
  return 'idle';
}
